intro: Gameweek 9, gentlemen, and the Premier League did its bit. Arsenal won 1-0 at Liverpool, Brighton won 1-0 at Man City, and Everton nicked one at Newcastle. Jamie topped the week with 51 and Louie propped it up with 30. Brahmes clocked 50 and jumped two places to 4th. Ben stays top on 460 and Asher sits second on 422, so the title race is not quite ON just yet. Josh and Louie each slipped a place, which is the polite way of saying they had a mare.
motw: Jamie, 51 points and a trophy for the week. Van Hecke scored and bagged 15, which is a lot for a defender who arrived on waivers. Tonali came in as well, so the transfer market is paying rent. The only blemish is Havertz, who sat on the bench with 9 points. Still, absolute scenes.
stinker: Louie, 30 points, bottom of the pile. Five midfielders on the scoresheet and none of them got past 6. Tzolis came on as an auto-sub for 3 points. The kindest thing to say is that Arsenal kept a clean sheet and he still found a way.
bench: Jonny left 20 points on the bench, and 11 of them were Verbruggen. The keeper made 7 saves, got 3 bonus and sat there with his gloves on. Boscagli added 6 more from the pine. The bench is where points go to die, and Jonny dug the grave himself.
red_card: Jack owned Mateta, who lasted 12 minutes, saw red and finished on minus 2. That is a very short shift for a man who still managed to concede twice. Palace lost 2-0 to Spurs, so Jack can at least say it was a team effort. Squeaky bum time for the transfer list.
gloves: Louie's Tzolakis kept goal for Hull in a 2-2 draw, conceded two and made one save. That earned a single point. Louie also owns a Tzolis, so this was a very Tzol-heavy week. Not a glove in sight, gentlemen.

xi.109: Verbruggen made 7 saves and took 3 bonus in Brighton's 1-0 win at Man City. Jonny owns him and left him on the bench. Absolutely brutal.
xi.112: Van Hecke scored, kept a clean sheet and grabbed 3 bonus for 15 points. A waiver pickup for Jamie, and a big reason he won the week.
xi.31: Konsa kept a clean sheet and piled up 15 defensive contributions for 10 points. Ben is quietly collecting points at the top of the table.
xi.230: Branthwaite got a clean sheet and 3 bonus for 9 points. Josh left him on the bench, which does not help the title bid.
xi.115: De Cuyper got an assist, a clean sheet and a yellow card on the way to 9 points. Asher got a good return from his Brighton man.
xi.40: Rogers scored in Chelsea's 2-0 win over Man Utd for 9 points. Brahmes is climbing the table for a reason.
xi.154: Palmer scored and kept a clean sheet against Man Utd for 8 points. Ben also owns him, so the leader stays comfortable.
xi.542: E.Le Fée scored for Sunderland in a 3-1 defeat and still collected 8 points. Josh got a goal and a bonus from a losing side. You can't buy that.
xi.295: McBurnie scored, assisted and took 3 bonus in Hull's 2-2 draw. 12 points for Asher. That is what we call played himself into form.
xi.26: Havertz scored for Arsenal at Liverpool and took 3 bonus for 9 points. Jamie benched him and still won the week. Show-off.
xi.79: Evanilson scored for Bournemouth in a 2-0 win over Leeds for 9 points. Another good return for Brahmes, who is having a lovely week.
